theorem length_eq_card_vertices (P : Polygon) : P.length = P.vertices.card := by
  have h := graphDegree_sum P.val
  change (∑ v ∈ P.vertices, graphDegree P.val v) = _ at h
  have hsum : (∑ v ∈ P.vertices, graphDegree P.val v) = 2 * (P.vertices.card : ℤ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v hv => P.degree_two v hv)]
    simp [mul_comm]
  rw [hsum] at h
  unfold length
  omega

theorem exists_pow_eq_pow_two_mul {p : ℕ} (hx : x ^ p = 1) (hp : Odd p) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m, x ^ n = x ^ (2 * m) := by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hp
  have key : x ^ (2 * (r + 1)) = x := by
    have h2 : 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [h2, pow_succ, hx, one_mul]
  exact ⟨(r + 1) * n, by rw [← mul_assoc, pow_mul, key]⟩

ex_openai.name: OAI.Barnette.TriangleSystem.Pair.bits_invariant
ex_openai.text:
theorem bits_invariant (P : @Pair A V T X) (Q : P.Group) (t : A) :
    P.bits Q (P.next t) = P.bits Q t := by
  have h0 := P.group_values Q t
  have h1 := P.group_values Q (P.next t)
  cases ht : P.bits Q t <;> cases hn : P.bits Q (P.next t)
  · rfl
  · simp only [ht, hn, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h0 h1
    exact False.elim (P.next_ne t (Q.val.right.value_injective
      (h1.2.trans ((P.value_next t).trans h0.2.symm))))
  · simp only [ht, hn, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h0 h1
    exact False.elim (P.next_ne t (Q.val.left.value_injective
      (h1.1.trans ((P.value_next t).trans h0.1.symm))))
  · rfl

      Radix.pushDigit a (Radix.pushDigit b 0) ≤ Radix.pushDigit a (Radix.pushDigit b 1) ∧
      Radix.pushDigit a (Radix.pushDigit b 1) ≤ 1 := by
  have ha := first_bounds a
  have hb := first_bounds b
  exact ⟨ha.1.trans ((Radix.prefix_le_prefix_iff a).mpr hb.1),
    (Radix.prefix_le_prefix_iff a).mpr hb.2.1,
    ((Radix.prefix_le_prefix_iff a).mpr hb.2.2).trans ha.2.2⟩

theorem group_gap (S : Type*) [Group S] [Fintype S] [Nontrivial S]

ex_openai.name: OAI.TreeEdit.BinaryLower.FiniteTree.extendPrefix_append
ex_openai.text:
theorem extendPrefix_append {m k : ℕ} (i₀ i : Fin m) (p : List (Fin m))
    (hp : p.length < k) :
    extendPrefix i₀ (p ++ [i]) = Function.update (extendPrefix i₀ p) ⟨p.length, hp⟩ i := by
  funext q
  by_cases hq : q.val < p.length
  · have hne : q ≠ ⟨p.length, hp⟩ := by intro he; subst q; simp at hq
    simp only [Function.update_of_ne hne, extendPrefix]
    exact List.getD_append p [i] i₀ q.val hq
  · have hq' : p.length ≤ q.val := Nat.le_of_not_gt hq
    by_cases he : q.val = p.length
    · have heq : q = ⟨p.length, hp⟩ := Fin.ext he
      subst q
      simp [extendPrefix, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    · have hne : q ≠ ⟨p.length, hp⟩ := by intro h; exact he (congrArg Fin.val h)
      simp only [Function.update_of_ne hne, extendPrefix]
      rw [List.getD_eq_default (p ++ [i]) i₀ (by simp; omega)]
      rw [List.getD_eq_default p i₀ hq']

ex_openai.name: OAI.Problem348.AnchorRigidity.host_nonanchor_row_one_group
ex_openai.text:
theorem host_nonanchor_row_one_group {h : ℕ}
    (r : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h)) (t : Mode h)
    (u v : Fin 64) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h))
    (hu : host (Sum.inr r) (Sum.inl (t, u, x)) = true)
    (hv : host (Sum.inr r) (Sum.inl (t, v, y)) = true) : u = v := by
  change decide ((u.val = 0 ∧ rowRole t 0 (Sum.inr r)) ∨
    (u.val = 1 ∧ rowRole t 1 (Sum.inr r))) = true at hu
  change decide ((v.val = 0 ∧ rowRole t 0 (Sum.inr r)) ∨
    (v.val = 1 ∧ rowRole t 1 (Sum.inr r))) = true at hv
  have hu' := of_decide_eq_true hu
  have hv' := of_decide_eq_true hv
  rcases hu' with ⟨hu0, hr0⟩ | ⟨hu1, hr1⟩
  · rcases hv' with ⟨hv0, _⟩ | ⟨_, hr1⟩
    · exact Fin.ext (hu0.trans hv0.symm)
    · exact False.elim (rowRole_disjoint t (Sum.inr r) ⟨hr0, hr1⟩)
  · rcases hv' with ⟨_, hr0⟩ | ⟨hv1, _⟩
    · exact False.elim (rowRole_disjoint t (Sum.inr r) ⟨hr0, hr1⟩)
    · exact Fin.ext (hu1.trans hv1.symm)

lemma excenter_eq_incenter_or_excenter_singleton (signs : Finset (Fin 3)) :

ex_mathlib.name: Real.two_mul_le_exp
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem two_mul_le_exp {x : ℝ} : 2 * x ≤ exp x := by
  by_cases hx0 : x < 0
  · exact le_trans (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by simp only [Nat.ofNat_nonneg]) hx0.le)
      (exp_nonneg x)
  · apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_not_gt hx0)) exp_one_mul_le_exp
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp 1
    rwa [one_add_one_eq_two] at this

private lemma czBall_subset_czBall {hX : GeneralCase f α} {i : ℕ} {b c : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b := by norm_num) (hbc : b ≤ c := by norm_num) :
    ball (czCenter hX i) (b * czRadius hX i) ⊆ ball (czCenter hX i) (c * czRadius hX i) := by
  by_cases hr : czRadius hX i ≥ 0
  · exact ball_subset_ball <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbc hr
  · simp [ball_eq_empty.mpr <| mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hb (le_of_not_ge hr)]

ex_openai.name: OAI.LeanBlast.CourtadeKumar.K_nonneg_of_rGap_nonneg
ex_openai.text:
theorem K_nonneg_of_rGap_nonneg
    (hgap : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < ell → 0 ≤ rGap s)
    (hslope : 0 ≤ rDeriv s0 - 2) (s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ K s := by
  by_cases hs : s ≤ 0
  · rw [K_eq_zero_of_nonpos hs]
  · have hs' : 0 < s := lt_of_not_ge hs
    by_cases hsc : s ≤ s0
    · rw [K_eq_rGap hs' hsc]
      exact hgap s hs'.le (hsc.trans_lt s0_lt_ell)
    · have hsc' : s0 < s := lt_of_not_ge hsc
      rw [K_eq_tangent hs' hsc'.le]
      exact add_nonneg (hgap s0 s0_pos.le s0_lt_ell)
        (mul_nonneg hslope (sub_nonneg.mpr hsc'.le))

ex_mathlib.text:
lemma cdf_measure_stieltjesFunction (f : StieltjesFunction ℝ) (hf0 : Tendsto f atBot (𝓝 0))
    (hf1 : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    cdf f.measure = f := by
  refine (cdf f.measure).eq_of_measure_of_tendsto_atBot f ?_ (tendsto_cdf_atBot _) hf0
  have h_prob : IsProbabilityMeasure f.measure :=
    ⟨by rw [f.measure_univ hf0 hf1, sub_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_one]⟩
  exact measure_cdf f.measure

ex_mathlib.name: SimplexCategory.eq_of_one_to_two'
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem eq_of_one_to_two' (f : ⦋1⦌ ⟶ ⦋2⦌) :
    f = (δ (n := 1) 0) ∨ f = (δ (n := 1) 1) ∨ f = (δ (n := 1) 2) ∨
      ∃ a, f = SimplexCategory.const _ _ a :=
  match eq_of_one_to_two f with
  | .inl ⟨0, h⟩ => .inl h
  | .inl ⟨1, h⟩ => .inr (.inl h)
  | .inl ⟨2, h⟩ => .inr (.inr (.inl h))
  | .inr h => .inr (.inr (.inr h))

  · exact ((List.mem_cons.1 h).elim Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr ⟨hab, h⟩))
